uncovered_item_details.paper_location: Supplement Eq. (S17) and following threshold statement, PDF p. 12
uncovered_item_details.scientific_object: Coordinates and existence threshold of the non-trivial semiclassical fixed points
direct_gap_statements: The fixed-point coordinates printed in Supplement Eq. (S17) fail both Eq. (S13) stationarity and unit norm, while the independently eliminated coordinates pass both checks.

direct_cause.statement: The fixed-point coordinates printed in Supplement Eq. (S17) fail both Eq. (S13) stationarity and unit norm, while the independently eliminated coordinates pass both checks.

root_cause.statement: Independent algebra, direct substitution, invariant checks, and fresh-context review all identify the same denominator error in the printed formula.

code_fault_assessment.statement: Exact rederivation, a separate numerical substitution, focused tests, parameter audit, invariants, and a current isolated run exclude a known reproduction-code cause.

checks.statement: Eliminating the printed governing equations gives D=kappa^2+4*omega_z^2 and the corrected coordinates.
Every symbol and test parameter is bound to the printed supplement or the frozen claim configuration.
A separate direct-substitution path evaluates printed and corrected coordinates without author code, arrays, or pixels.
Stationarity and unit-norm residuals separate the corrected and printed expressions far above roundoff.
Focused tests require corrected branches to pass and the printed branches to fail.
The current isolated claim run completed with bound inputs and no forbidden source access.

next_discriminating_test.action: Ask the authors for an erratum or an alternative convention that makes the printed Eq. (S17) satisfy Eq. (S13).
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: An erratum confirms the discrepancy, or a precise convention falsifies this diagnosis.
